Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity

Class DumbEntity

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.Entity
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.entity.DumbEntity
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Listener
Direct Known Subclasses:
HumanoidEntity, YamlDumbEntity
public abstract class DumbEntity extends Entity
Abstract base class for custom entities without a default AI.

Provides common properties and methods for entities that do not have built-in vanilla behavior. Handles AI instantiation and teardown on death, and pushes configured moveSpeed / aggroRange into the AI instance at spawn time.
